name: Ahmad Shah
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. Initially working in corporate security in Kuala Lumpur, he was drawn to the high-stakes environment of racing events during a local Grand Prix. The intensity and fast-paced nature resonated with his meticulous approach, and he transitioned into motorsport security, starting at the ground level. He believes a strong security presence is the backbone of any successful racing team. 

Ahmad is known for his systematic and thorough approach. He's committed to learning the most up-to-date techniques and procedures. While fairly new to top-tier racing security, he is eager to apply his skills and dedication to the team, ensuring the safety of personnel, equipment, and intellectual property. He is driven by a strong sense of duty, understanding that even the smallest oversight can have significant consequences.

physical.description: Ahmad is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Insists on performing a final security check personally before any major event.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
